lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents per km² of land. Each municipality's population is spread over its hexes in proportion to how much of the municipality each hex covers. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Mean age
lenses.description: Mean age of residents, from the census 5-year age groups (group midpoints; 85+ counted as 90): the one measure both censuses allow. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Aged 65+
lenses.description: Share of residents aged 65 and over. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Growth
lenses.description: Population change from the 2011 census to the latest one (2022; 2024 in KiM), on today's municipal borders. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Blank where the 2011 count is not usable: Preševo and Bujanovac (most Albanians boycotted it) and KiM's four northern municipalities (not enumerated).

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.unit: unemployed share of the labour force
lenses.description: Unemployed ÷ economically active residents at the census (15+ in Serbia, 15–64 in KiM). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: In Leposavić, Zvečan, Zubin Potok and Severna Kosovska Mitrovica most Serbs boycotted the 2024 census, so only population, age and ethnicity (which include the statisticians' estimate) are shown there.

lenses.name: Wages
lenses.description: Average net monthly wage of employees living in the municipality (RZS), converted at the year's average exchange rate (GDP in dinars ÷ GDP in euros). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Kosovo and Metohija has no municipal figure for this: its hexes are blank.

lenses.name: GDP per person
lenses.description: GDP per resident. Statistics publish value added per okrug (Serbia) and for KiM as a whole; each municipality's share is estimated from its employees by activity, so this is an estimate (≈), and it is counted where the work is done while residents are counted where they live. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Degrees
lenses.unit: residents 15+ with a college or university degree
lenses.description: Share of residents aged 15 and over whose highest finished school is a college (više) or university (visoko), of those whose education is known. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: In Leposavić, Zvečan, Zubin Potok and Severna Kosovska Mitrovica most Serbs boycotted the 2024 census, so only population, age and ethnicity (which include the statisticians' estimate) are shown there.

lenses.name: No primary school
lenses.description: Share of residents aged 15 and over with no schooling or unfinished primary school (in KiM: no schooling or only the first five grades). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: In Leposavić, Zvečan, Zubin Potok and Severna Kosovska Mitrovica most Serbs boycotted the 2024 census, so only population, age and ethnicity (which include the statisticians' estimate) are shown there.

lenses.name: Largest people
lenses.description: The largest national community of the municipality by the census declaration ("other" and undeclared left out).
lenses.note: A census declaration, voluntary and self-chosen. KiM figures are ASK's 2024 census.

lenses.name: Largest faith
lenses.description: The religion most residents of the municipality declared at the census.
lenses.note: A census declaration of religious affiliation, not practice. In Leposavić, Zvečan, Zubin Potok and Severna Kosovska Mitrovica most Serbs boycotted the 2024 census, so only population, age and ethnicity (which include the statisticians' estimate) are shown there.

lenses.name: Believers
lenses.description: Residents who declared a religion, per 100 (those who did not answer count as not declaring one).
lenses.note: A census declaration of religious affiliation, not practice. In Leposavić, Zvečan, Zubin Potok and Severna Kosovska Mitrovica most Serbs boycotted the 2024 census, so only population, age and ethnicity (which include the statisticians' estimate) are shown there.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land covered by forest or woodland (CORINE 311–313, 324, 244). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is arable land, vineyards, orchards or pasture (CORINE 211–243). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is urban fabric, industry or transport (CORINE 111–124, 133). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
